column1: # Farming XP per seed, scraped from the OSRS Wiki '<Type> patch/Seeds' subpages.
# Regenerate: see TODO.md. Values are per seed/crop, not per patch.
# 'check' is the one-off check-health XP; ordinary trees give no per-harvest XP at all.
# Fruit trees are the exception: they pay a check award AND per fruit. The patch/Seeds page
# gives only one unlabelled total, so those rows come from each seed's own page, which states
# the three components separately. Six of the eight reconcile exactly against the summary
# table's total (plant + check + 6 x harvest), which is what makes the split trustworthy.
# Two do not, and the gap is in the check figure both times:
# The seed pages are used, being the ones that state the components rather than deriving them.
# A single clean check-health XP drop settles either outright - no averaging needed - and
# HarvestLog warns on any mismatch, so playing normally will answer it.
